description: Demonstration of Simulation Tools for Electricity Markets considering Power Flow Analysis is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Bruno Veiga, Gabriel Santos (GECAD - ISEP/IPP). Two novel publicly available web services for electricity market (EM) simulation and study and power flow evaluation and validation are proposed, namely the Electricity Market Service (EMS) and Power Flow Service (PFS). EMS enables the simulation of two auction-based algorithms and the execution of three wholesale EMs. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
